name: github-pitch-black-theme
description: A zero-latency, high-performance pitch black theme for GitHub. Multi-browser web extension source.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@latest lint --source-dir=dist/firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && npx --yes web-ext@latest build --source-dir=dist/chrome --artifacts-dir=dist/artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@latest build --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=dist/artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:all: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
